entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ハナコ様、お会いできて光栄です" t="It is a true honor to meet you, Hanako-sama." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ハナコ様、お会いできて光栄です" t="Este o adevărată onoare să vă întâlnesc, Hanako-sama." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="こちらこそ" t="The honor is mine." b="" a=""/>
